name: page-models-tab
goal: Pages show a Models tab instead of Contract, with revision-bound data models reached through page dependencies

evidence: Pages replace Contract with Models; show distinct active models through components and services at the selected revision; preserve model links and non-page contracts; cover historical empty states and three viewports. Existing coverage asserted Contract on every visual page and never traversed nested model dependencies.

Replaced the Page Contract tab with Models, added revision-bound transitive model discovery, reused catalog cards with consumer lists omitted in this context, and canonicalized legacy Page Contract links to Models. Existing model links and other entity contracts are preserved.

Red: existing relations assertions and all three browser viewport cases failed on Contract and missing nested model data. Green: 61 route tests, full Reports unit suite, and all 10 affected browser tests pass; tests cover nested models, cycles, duplicates, unrelated and inactive models, revision scope, empty history, and model navigation. Manually exercised seven actual models and View More in the in-app browser.
